questions.topic: Foundations of Psychology: A Term With No Procedure Attached
questions.stem: Explain the danger of using an unoperationalised term in a study, per the notes.

answer.exemplar: It allows circular reasoning and makes findings impossible to test or replicate.

questions.explanation: Unoperationalised terms enable circular reasoning and block testing and replication.

questions.topic: Foundations of Psychology: One Construct Measured Two Ways
questions.stem: Synthesise the lesson about measurement from the revision notes.
